adopt: Enroll one machine by MAC, arm pxe-once or run an in-place bootc preflight, and watch greenboot flip the host back to localboot automatically after first healthy boot.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Reimaging bare-metal boxes across x86_64 and aarch64 usually means walking USB sticks, fighting router DHCP leases, risking PXE boot loops, or running ad-hoc scripts that drop Wi-Fi, Tailscale, SELinux labels, or Secure Boot checks on first boot.

Install
not on PyPI yet (pending publish); builds in-tree

Commands
  awboot
synopsis: Verifiable PXE, iPXE, UEFI HTTP Boot, and in-place bootc bare-metal provisioning for x86_64 and aarch64 fleets.
